settings.title: Settings

desc.loaderWindow: Show a loader window before the main window appears
desc.startMinimized: Launch the app minimized to the system tray
desc.alwaysOnTop: Keep Next Music above all other windows
desc.freeWindowResize: Remove the minimum window size constraint
desc.nextTitle: Replaces the system window title with ”Next Music”
desc.checkUpdates: Automatically check for updates on startup
desc.rpcTitle: Application name shown in your Discord status
desc.largeImageUrl: Clickable URL on the large Discord activity image
desc.trackButton: Show a button linking to the current track
desc.githubButton: Show a button linking to the Next Music repository
desc.listenAlongButton: Show a button that invites people into your Listen Along room
desc.onlineScripts: URLs to JavaScript files. (One per line)
desc.exposeNetwork: Allow other devices on your network to reach the widget on port 4091
desc.alwaysExpandedPlayer: Expands the Yandex Music player panel
desc.disableAutoZoom: Disables automatic scaling of the Yandex Music interface
desc.antiSelect: Disable text selection everywhere, except for synchronized lyrics
desc.ugcShare: Allow UGC tracks to be shared
desc.fastPlay: Plays a track when pressing Ctrl + V with a saved link or a direct ID
desc.lrclib: Enables loading synchronized lyrics from lrclib.net
